targets the gap between fixed-state sequence models and full attention. Structured state-space models and selective recurrent models compress an unbounded history into a bounded state, which keeps inference cheap but limits associative recall to roughly the state dimension. Attention removes that cap by storing one key-value entry per token, but its cache grows with sequence length and its compute is quadratic. The paper asks whether there is a middle regime: a memory that grows only when the input is genuinely novel, so memory size tracks the number of distinct items rather than the number of tokens. In practical terms, the problem is how to add content-addressable, expandable memory to a deep recurrent or SSM backbone without falling back to per-token storage.","importance":"Its value is conceptual and architectural rather than immediately recipe-changing for large-scale pretraining. The contribution is using the online DP-means allocation rule as the memory operator of a deep sequence model. That makes the cache scale with distinct items, not tokens, and gives a concrete mechanism for a “semantic compressibility-aware” memory budget. DeepNorm was derived for untied depth, where each layer owns its own parameters, so it does not directly apply here. The Sparse-TC layer reshapes part of the nonzero pattern into a form that can use sparse tensor cores. The Slot-Filling layer applies parallel differential-distance encoding to compress irregular positions while keeping on-chip decoding cheap. The Residual Layer stores remaining entries that cannot be represented by the first two layers, preserving exact SpMM computation. The accompanying kernel co-schedules sparse tensor cores and CUDA cores: tensor cores handle the structured accelerated portion, while CUDA cores manage decoding and residual work. The execution pipeline is designed to overlap on-chip computation with HBM traffic. It also explains why first-order selectors based on mean-pooled keys can fail: they capture the block mean but ignore how the keys vary along the query direction. An oracle selector using exact mass nearly matches dense attention, which suggests that the main problem is estimating the mass cheaply. COBS derives a second-order selector from a cumulant expansion of the block contribution. The first-order term is the query dot product with the block mean key. The second-order term uses the within-block key covariance, capturing variance in the query direction. 组织成若干彼此独立的线性序列，而是组织成一棵共享前缀的树。这样做有两个直接目的。其一，公共前缀只算一次，减少重复计算；其二，树结构天然要求分支在更靠后的层级才分化，能把并行预算更多用在真正不同的语义路径上。\n\n具体机制分三部分。第一是 tree construction。作者先用若干 seed nodes 初始化 drafting tree，这些 seed 可以来自随机采样或上下文语义启发。树中每个节点只能 attend 到自己的祖先节点，借此保证每条路径仍符合 AR 因果约束；位置编码则按祖先链长度分配，使树输入仍兼容标准 Transformer。\n\n第二是 progressive evolution。PTD 不是一次性把整棵树铺开，而是逐步扩展。每一轮 forward pass 后，根据当前节点的预测结果扩展候选子节点，再结合 ","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-11T05:54:00Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2607_10137.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很工程化的问题：为什么 的质量。这对后续做量化感知训练、训练期鲁棒性设计、甚至预训练阶段的激活分布整形都有启发。第二，它指出很多 PTQ 分析默认激活近似高斯，但在 LLaMA-3-8B 上 84% 层不满足这个假设，且层间方差增长达到 6548 倍，说明深层 residual 的统计性质远比常见近似更尖锐、更异质。第三，方法本身没有改 kernel，没有引入运行时开销，输出仍是标准 group-128 Compensation，也就是顺序式、drift-aware 的校准流程。它不是重新发明量化公式，而是改了“校准时看什么分布”。标准 AWQ/GPTQ/LeanQuant 一类方法，通常对每层独立校准，并默认该层输入来自 FP16 模型的干净激活。CEC 则按层顺序处理：先量化前面层，再把校准数据跑过当前已经部分量化的模型，捕获第 l 层真实会看到的 drifted 个代表点。问题在于 M 是固定的，所有区域精度一样。AVQ 的做法是先用一层较粗的 parent codeword 做近似，再根据当前输入前向传播中得到的注意力质量分布，选出最重要的若干 parent，对这些区域展开更细的 child codeword。这样，高注意力区域得到更细量化，低注意力区域维持粗粒度表示。\n\n这里真正有技术含量的部分有三处。第一，importance signal block，并通过在线 softmax 的增量更新和 parent-child 约束做 in-register correction。\n\n复杂度上，作者声称维持与标准 VQ-attention 相同的 O(MN)，只是把固定预算改成自适应预算分配。实现上还提供了 Triton kernel，把量化、聚合和修正过程尽量融合，减少 memory query 对大量候选 key 的相关性分数，又要做逐行 top-k 选择。现有 GPU 实现通常把“算分”和“选 top-k”拆成两步，先把完整 score matrix 写回 HBM，再做选择。这样做在 1M 级上下文下会同时带来三类代价：显存占用高、HBM 读写流量大、同步和选择开销重。论文指出，在 DeepSeek Sparse Attention score materialization 和 top-k selection 吃掉收益。LiteTopK 的价值是把这个瓶颈重新定义成一个 fused kernel 设计问题，并利用高维相似度分布集中这一统计性质来减少无效写回。它更像 serving / inference kernel 的工作，但对长上下文预训练和推理一体化系统都有启发：如果稀疏注意力的索引阶段不能做成低内存、低 I/O 的 sample。作者利用 sparse attention 的局部平稳性：相邻 token chunk 往往关注相近的历史 token，因此当前 chunk 的分数分布和前一个 chunk 相似。LiteTopK 直接拿前一 chunk 的 top-k' 分数作为轻量样本，文中在 DSA 上取 k'=3k，用它估计当前 chunk 的 score range。第二步是 quantize + histogram。把估计出的分数范围做等宽分桶，建立 histogram，定位包含局部 top-k 元素的 threshold bin。第三步是 fused filtering。真正遍历所有候选时，不再把完整 score 写回 HBM，而是边算边根据当前 threshold bin 的上界过滤掉明显不可能进入 top-k 的候选，只对保留下来的少量分数做写回和后续选择。\n\n实现上有几个值得注意的点。其一，作者把“算 score”改写成“直接算 bin id”，尽量不增加额外算子延迟。其二，histogram 更新没有用锁，而是让空闲 warps 通过 overwrite write 式更新，接受轻微陈旧、略松的阈值，因为这不会破坏正确性，只会影响过滤强度。其三，方法依赖的是高维相似度的集中现象：大多数分数挤在一个窄区间里，真正高分是长尾少数，因此阈值一旦建立，过滤率会很高。和传统 exact top-k kernel 相比，它不是先完整 materialize 再 select，而是把近似分布估计嵌进主路径，尽量把无效候选挡在 HBM cross-runner audit。每个 runner 在固定轴上比较两种条件，并对重叠 case 进行 K=50、temperature=1.0 的采样，最终形成 26.5 万个样本、5300 个 case-result rows、394 个唯一题目。三个控制轴分别是：模型 tier（gpt-4.1 nano vs mini）、prompt 策略（mini zero-shot vs mini CoT）、mid-tier vs frontier（mini vs gpt-4.1）。这种设计的价值在于，同一题会被不同人、不同 prompt 复现，因而可以估计某个 confident wrong answer 是偶然采样产物，还是跨运行复发的系统偏差。\n\n第二，作者把 agreement 明确拆成可分析的统计量。文中核心量包括：C，通常表示某题在 K 次采样中的多数答案占比，可理解为自一致性强度；A，准确性；M，多数投票后的是否答对或相关聚合指标。分析上使用 hierarchical runner-clustered bootstrap，并做 multiplicity control，尽量避免把 runner 间相关性误当成显著性。这个统计处理很重要，因为数据不是理想独立同分布：runner 共享课程背景，也可能共享代码或讨论。\n\n第三，作者做了两个很有信息量的控制。一个是 recurrence analysis：看错误答案是否在不同 runner / prompt 下反复出现，用来识别 shared bias 或 memorized heuristic。另一个是 GPQA 的 option-shuffle control：把四选一选项位置打乱，检验高 agreement 是否部分来自位置先验而非知识或推理。这个控制直接说明，在小答案空间任务里，agreement 很容易被 answer-space geometry 污染。文末还做了一个 exploratory cross-family check，用 Claude 三个 tier 复核 GPT 家族观察，发现较小 tier 上跨 provider 的同错现象高于保持边际分布的 null，说明 shared bias 不只存在于同一家模型族。","experiments":"实验主集是 GPQA Diamond 和 AIME，故意选了两个答案空间差异很大的 benchmark。GPQA 是四选一，随机也能有 25% 的一致性地板，因此真正有区分度的是高 C 区域；AIME 是 0 到 999 的整数答案，大答案空间下只有模型真会做题时一致性才会上来。这个设置让作者能观察 agreement signal 如何受 answer-space 影响。\n\n主要结果有几条。第一，self-consistency 多数投票依然能提准确率，这一点没有被否定；但“agreement 强度能否预测 correctness”只呈现弱正相关，而且依赖模型层级。中档模型处在 agreement 未饱和区间时，这个信号还有一定排序价值；frontier 模型已经高度一致，但准确率并没有同步提高，于是 calibration 变差。作者把这一现象解释为 over-confident frontier model：更稳定，但不更对。\n\n第二，CoT prompt 对准确率有帮助，但对 agreement-correctness 关系只带来边际改善。也就是说，CoT 让模型更会做题，不等于让 agreement 更像一个可靠置信度。这个结果对很多“多采样 CoT + 置信路由”的系统是个提醒。\n\n第三，confidence-routed cascade 的结果不理想，甚至被“始终使用 mid-tier model”支配。换句话说，如果路由依据是这个不够可靠的 agreement signal，把样本送到 frontier 模型未必划算，可能只是把预算花在一个更自信但不更准的模型上。\n\n第四，GPQA 的 option shuffle 显示一部分所谓 confidence 来自选项位置偏置。对于四选一题，这个发现很关键，因为它说明高一致性可能只是模型稳定地偏爱某个位置或某类表面模式。\n\n第五，探索性 Claude 复核与 GPT 结果方向一致：frontier tier 的 agreement 也更容易脱离真实准确率；而较小 tier 间出现同错，说明跨模型 agreement 也可能只是共享偏差。摘要里提到 GPT 与 Claude 在两个较小 tier 上选择同一错误答案的频率高于边际保持 null。论文没有把这部分包装成强结论，处理得比较克制。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 Introduction 和实验设定，抓住作者到底在审计什么：不是“self-consistency 有没有用”，而是“agreement 能不能当 confidence”。然后重点看定义 C/A/M 的部分，以及各轴对比图，尤其是 stochastic samples, or agreement across different LLM judges, can serve as a reliable confidence signal for correctness. The target is not majority-vote decoding itself. The target is the downstream use of agreement as a proxy for confidence in routing, abstention, adaptive compute allocation, and LLM-as-judge pipelines. The key question is when repeated agreement reflects genuine certainty, and when it merely reflects shared bias, positional priors, memorized heuristics, or post-training-induced overconfidence. The main conclusion is that agreement is only a weak, regime-dependent proxy for correctness, and it degrades most noticeably on the most consistent frontier model.","importance":"Its value for foundation-model researchers is diagnostic rather than algorithmic. Many current systems implicitly treat agreement as calibrated uncertainty. This paper shows that the assumption breaks precisely where practitioners are most tempted to trust it: on stable, highly aligned frontier models. That matters for post-training, evaluation, and inference-time control. If RLHF or related post-training stages compress output diversity without proportionally improving truthfulness, then self-consistency becomes a distorted signal. The paper also matters for any future use of agreement in training loops, such as data filtering, curriculum design, or self-generated supervision. Before agreement can be used as a training signal, one must separate recurring true confidence from recurring false certainty. 的意义主要有三点。第一，它更适合区分“记忆窗口变长”与“证据组织能力变强”这两件事。第二，它能更真实地暴露模型在 source-grounded reasoning 上的短板，尤其是证据必要性、关系塌缩、局部捷径等问题。第三，它为后续做长上下文预训练、文档级数据构造、过程监督、检索-推理接口设计提供了更可操作的误差分解框架。","technical_approach":"方法上最关键的是 source-first 构造，而不是 question-first。作者从 214 份公开长文档源出发，覆盖技术事故报告和较少被公众熟知的文学叙事。先把每个 source 切成重叠窗口，再把局部上下文转成 evidence record，记录实体、事件、属性、时间标记、引语、局部关系和短摘要等信息。随后把这些 record 连成一个带类型的 source-internal graph；只有当原文局部上下文明确支持两条事实之间的关系时，才加边。接着不是人工随意出题，而是用几类“evidence geometry”在图上挖自然形成的证据轨迹，包括 forward chains、intersections、comparisons、temporal reconstructions、causal fan-in、abductive explanations、counterfactual branches 七类。也就是说，题目先由文档内部结构诱导出来，再由人工写成公开问题、参考答案、关键事实和 rubric。\n\n作者对 benchmark fidelity 的控制做得比较细。候选样本是高召回挖掘出来的，但进入正式集之前要过多道门。四类主要威胁分别是：source grounding、multi-hop necessity、shortcut resistance、answerability。对应地，他们做了 grounding 检查，确保答案、关键事实、证据 span 和评分标准都能被原文支持；做 leave-one-out 和 single-clue ablation，排除掉删去部分证据后仍能唯一作答的伪 multi-hop 样本；做 no-document probe，过滤公共常识或污染导致的无文档作答；还做 evidence-conditioned 检查，验证隐藏 trail 一旦提供，是否足以支持答案。再加上人工审核和外部审计，去掉 unsupported facts、冗余线索、歧义答案和几何类型不匹配的样本。这个流程的重点不是规模，而是尽量把“自然证据链”这个概念落到可验证的数据工艺上。","experiments":"数据构造上，作者从 214 个长文档源中得到 3,506 个带验证跟踪的候选 trail-question artifact，最终公开集保留 481 个任务，存活率 13.7%。这个数字本身说明自然证据链 benchmark 很难做：高召回挖掘不难，难的是把伪多跳、局部捷径、公共知识泄漏和答案歧义清掉。\n\n从全文给出的实验意图看，重点不是刷一个大而全的榜，而是证明现有模型在这种“证据未显式给出”的长文档推理上仍有明显缺口。作者区分了两类能力：一类是 evidence discovery，另一类是 relation 下仍可解，就会被剔除，这使得最终集对“多证据必要性”更严格。由于你给出的全文片段没有完整榜单数字，我不编造具体模型分数；但从构造与验证设计可以明确看出，这个 benchmark 的实验价值主要体现在错误类型分解，而不是单一平均分。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先看 Introduction，把作者为什么不满意 agent-specific alignment、tool-use safety、trajectory-level reward/penalty 设计都有参考意义。","technical_approach":"方法由四部分组成。第一是 ANCHOR-Seed 数据管线。作者从 CourtListener 的 1000 万级美国法院公开记录中，围绕美国法典 Title 18 的 450 个犯罪条目检索到 5770 份 opinion texts，再用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 抽取案件场景与被告实施的具体行为。之后做“computer-assistable”分类，判断该犯罪是否有足够时间且计算机在执行中是否关键，最终得到 2296 个可由计算机辅助实施的案例。接着用 Qwen3-235B 把原始法律叙述改写成中性、任务导向、但语义等价的用户请求，去掉“fraud”“guilty”这类显式危险词，并通过多模型 judge 做一致性与去显式有害词验证。\n\n第二是强审计者构建。作者认为普通 helpful-only auditor 不够“执着”，会低估风险，因此专门训练 auditor model，使其更擅长扮演持续、策略性、会绕过拒答的恶意用户。训练信号来自 dark personality data，并结合 SFT 与 RFT/RL，使模型学会分解任务、改写请求、在被拒后换策略，而不是只做浅层角色扮演。推理时 auditor agent 还带有私有 ToDo list 用于隐藏式规划，并配备五类 auditing strategies 的工具箱，再通过 ICRL 做测试时自适应调整。\n\n第三是 CLI-agent 仿真环境。评测覆盖 harm、risk、任务完成度等维度，并用多模型裁判减少单一 judge 偏差。整体设计思路很明确：不是让 target model 在显式违法提示上表态，而是让它在真实世界风格的模糊请求、持续诱导和工具环境中自己走出一条轨迹，再判断这条轨迹的危害等级。","experiments":"关键结果很集中。作者评测了 8 个前沿模型，在直接 harmful prompt This work reveals measurement error in existing short-answer VQA benchmarks: official scores do not purely reflect a model's semantic capability, but are confounded by surface-form matching. This has direct implications for the reliability of model comparisons and ablation studies that use VQA benchmarks in pretraining research. The proposed answer contract framework also provides a reference for designing more reliable multimodal evaluation protocols and optimizing pretraining output alignment objectives.","technical_approach":"1) A decomposition framework is proposed: official score is split into two independent quantities — semantic acceptability S_sem(o) (whether the answer content is correct) and benchmark contract compatibility κ(o) (whether the answer format matches evaluation rules) — to distinguish true negatives (semantically incorrect answers) from false negatives (semantically correct but format-mismatched answers). 2) Two human-validated semantic judges are used to audit official errors: a multimodal judge (97.6% precision) and a text-only judge, to rule out bias from a single audit model. 3) An answer contract taxonomy is introduced, categorizing answers into scalar, extractive, multi-span, identifier, and other types, to structurally analyze the sources of evaluator sensitivity. 4) The work further studies how benign prompt changes (which do not alter task semantics) affect evaluation results, and the effectiveness of lightweight contract repair.","experiments":"Experiments cover 6 VLMs (4 open-weight, 2 closed-source) and 6 short-answer VQA benchmarks (ST-VQA, TextVQA, DocVQA, InfographicVQA, ChartQA, etc.), totaling over 41,000 questions, with audits of over 37,000 official errors. incre","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-09T12:54:05Z","category_id":"multimodal","cover_url":"/covers/2607_08434.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作要解决的问题是：统一大多模态模型在 interleaved multimodal reasoning 中，为什么引入中间视觉状态后仍然低效且不够好。作者认为瓶颈不在“模型会不会生成图像”，而在于现有方法把每一步视觉推理都当成一次完整图像生成。对于连续的推理轨迹，相邻视觉状态往往高度相似，真正推动推理的是少量关键变化。若每一步都重建整张图，训练信号会被大量不变内容稀释，计算也会被冗余视觉 token 吃掉。论文的核心问题因此是：能否把中间视觉状态建模成状态更新，而不是整图重生成，从而让统一模型更适合做多步视觉推理。","importance":"从基座研究角度，这篇工作的价值主要在建模视角，而不是单个 benchmark 分数。它提出了一种对 unified multimodal modeling 更自然的状态转移表述：在 reasoning 过程中，视觉分支不一定要反复生成完整观测，而可以只生成增量更新。这个想法和语言模型里的 residual / delta 建模、视频中的帧间冗余利用、以及多模态 token budget 分配问题是相通的。对预训练研究者来说，启发在于两点。第一，统一 AR+视觉生成模型里，视觉 token 的语义粒度和时间冗余是关键瓶颈，不能只看“能不能生成”，还要看“生成什么最有训练价值”。第二，若未来多模态基座要支持长程交互、具身推理、视觉草图式思考，update-centric 表示可能比 full-state 表示更可扩展。不过这篇更偏方法与系统设计，对纯文本 LLM 预训练的直接影响有限。","technical_approach":"方法由三个部分组成。\n\n第一部分是 update-centric visual modeling。DeltaV 不再在每个 reasoning step 生成完整中间图像，而是条件于历史视觉状态，只预测当前步相对前一状态的“视觉更新 token”。这样做的动机很直接：把建模容量集中在变化区域和变化语义上，避免重复编码不变背景或已知结构。论文把 interleaved reasoning 重新表述为 visual state transition，而不是 image-by-image generation。\n\n第二部分是 TSIM Router。作者注意到不同 step 之间的变化幅度差异很大，如果固定每一步都分配同样多的 update token，会在简单变化上浪费预算，在复杂变化上又不够。因此他们设计 temporal similarity router，根据相邻状态的相似度来决定 token budget。具体做法是先把样本按变化幅度分到不同 TSIM 区间，再为每个区间拟合 reconstruction-quality-token 曲线；当继续增加 token 带来的重建质量边际收益低于阈值时，就停止分配。这样，高相似状态只用少量 token，复杂转移则分配更多 token。这个设计的重点不是一个复杂路由器网络，而是把 token 数量和状态变化量显式绑定。\n\n第三部分是训练数据 StructCoT。作者认为现有 interleaved multimodal reasoning 数据集过于局限，多集中在迷宫、拼图、视觉搜索等窄场景，不足以支撑通用更新式推理。因此他们构建了 1.05M 样本、44 个任务域的数据集，覆盖更丰富的 reasoning structure 和 visual update pattern。对这类模型来说，数据资产和建模方式是耦合的：如果训练数据里没有足够多的状态转移模式，update-centric 建模很难学到稳定策略。\n\n从范式上看，DeltaV 不是简单压缩视觉 token，而是在统一模型内部改变监督对象：从“重建当前整图”改为“预测导致状态变化的增量”。这会让优化更聚焦于因果相关的视觉变化，而不是低层像素保真。","experiments":"正文片段给出的数字有限，但几项关键信息是明确的。首先，训练数据规模是 1.05M StructCoT，覆盖 44 个任务域，这说明作者不是只在少量合成任务上验证，而是试图做更通用的 interleaved reasoning 训练。其次，主实验结论是 visual-update paradigm 相比 full-image generation paradigm 更有效，尤其是在需要多步视觉状态演化的任务上。作者强调两类收益：一是减少视觉 token 冗余，二是把监督集中到 reasoning-critical transitions The authors argue that the issue is not visual generation itself, but the assumption that every reasoning step must generate a full image. In many reasoning trajectories, consecutive visual states are highly similar, and only a small subset of changes actually matters for the next step. Reconstructing the entire image at every step wastes tokens, spends supervision on unchanged content, and weakens credit assignment for the transitions that drive reasoning. The core problem is therefore whether intermediate visual reasoning should be modeled as state updates rather than repeated full-image generation.","importance":"For foundation-model research, the main contribution is a modeling perspective rather than a benchmark headline. The paper proposes a more natural state-transition view for unified multimodal modeling: during reasoning, the visual branch does not always need to regenerate the full observation and can instead emit incremental updates. This connects to broader issues in pretraining and representation learning: token budget allocation, temporal redundancy, and the granularity of supervision in multimodal models. The practical implication is that future multimodal base models aimed at long-horizon interaction, embodied reasoning, or sketch-like visual thinking may need update-centric representations rather than full-state representations. The direct impact on text-only LLM pretraining is limited, but the paper is relevant to multimodal pretraining because it changes what the model is asked to predict.","technical_approach":"$71","experiments":"$72","reading_guide":"$73","authors_note":""},"recommendation":{"zh":"多模态统一建模中用增量视觉更新替代全图生成的思路可复用在多步推理场景，重点看§3的TSIM路由器设计和StructCoT数据集构造细节。","en":"The incremental visual state update paradigm for ULMMs is reusable for multi-step multimodal reasoning; focus on §3 TSIM router design and StructCoT dataset construction."},"metadata":{"institutions":[],"authors":["Pengjie Wang","Linger Deng","Zujia Zhang","Shaojie Zhang","Zhenbo Luo","Pei Fu","Jian Luan","Xiang Bai","Yuliang Liu"],"notable_authors":["Xiang Bai"],"tags":["unified multimodal model","visual state update","multimodal reasoning","token routing","multimodal dataset"],"links":{"arxiv":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08434","pdf":"https://arxiv.org/pdf/2607.08434","github":null,"project":null,"source_url":null,"article":null}}},{"id":"2607.08639","title":"Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control","abstract":"The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. This matters for CLIP-like dual encoders and also for broader multimodal pretraining, where alignment losses can be harmful if they ignore what part of one modality is actually supervised by the other.","technical_approach":"AspectCLIP replaces unconstrained global consistency with aspect-guided consistency. It first clusters captions using SimCSE embeddings, relying on text semantics to identify the aspect of the image being described. Samples within the same cluster are treated as aspect-coherent, while samples from different clusters are treated as potentially aspect-divergent. The regularizer is then split into two regimes. Within a cluster, the method applies full cyclic consistency at the sample level, strengthening fine-grained geometric alignment for a shared descriptive aspect. Across clusters, it avoids direct sample-to-sample constraints and instead aligns samples with cluster prototypes, which gives a weaker and smoother cross-aspect constraint. Compared with CyCLIP-style global regularization, the key change is not the presence of a consistency term, but the decision rule for when strict consistency is semantically appropriate.","experiments":"The experiments evaluate standard CLIP capabilities, including zero-shot classification, zero-shot retrieval, and linear probing, together with representation consistency metrics. CO²Jump consistently improves joint text-image metrics over existing samplers (standard MDM sampler of Sahoo et al., ReMDM, and a parallel multimodal MDM baseline), with gains also on individual modalities. plausibl","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-07-08T23:00:54Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2607_07976.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL","cs.AI","cs.LG"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 上。贡献量级不在于提出一个全新的 RL 框架，而在于把一个此前常被经验性归因的训练退化现象明确化，并给出一个几乎不增加训练开销的修正项。如果后续 RLVR 继续沿着 GRPO 这条线扩展，这类“只修 credit、不加 critic”的方法会比较实用。","technical_approach":"方法叫 TACO，核心思路是：不要重新估计每个 token 对最终 reward 的因果贡献，而是先判断这个 token 在当前上下文下是否像一个“高风险尾部 token”，再只对正向 credit 做软抑制。这样做的取舍很明确：它放弃了精细的 token-level return decomposition，换来低开销和更稳定的工程实现。\n\n从论文给出的机制看，TACO 先利用 generation-time 的局部统计量来刻画 token 风险，重点是 sampled token probability 在当前上下文下的位置，以及与局部熵相关的分布形态。直观上，如果一个 token 是在高不确定位置被采样出来的正常探索，不能简单压掉；但如果它同时处在分布尾部、又表现出局部语义不协调，那么它更像是“被奖励轨迹裹挟”的噪声 token。TACO据此构造一个 tail-aware risk score，再把原本统一广播的正 advantage 乘上一个随风险单调减小的校准因子。低风险 token 保留原有强化，高风险 token 的正更新被削弱；负 advantage 一侧则不做同样处理，避免削弱对错误行为的惩罚。\n\n这和已有几类方法的区别比较清楚。第一类方法用 counterfactual、execution feedback、TD propagation 去估计 token 贡献，信号更细，但代价高，而且常需要额外推理。第二类方法用 entropy、surprisal、KL 等内禀量做重要性加权，但它们更像“哪些 token 值得学”，不直接回答“哪些 token 不该因全局正奖励而被强化”。TACO的切入点更窄：它不是找关键 token，而是找不该拿正 credit 的 token。这个问题定义更保守，也更容易做成低成本插件。","experiments":"实验覆盖三种 LLM、六个数学推理基准，以及两个 OOD 科学推理基准。论文主结论是：TACO 在所有设置下都稳定优于 GRPO-style baseline，并且在长程训练里更稳，没有出现前期涨、后期回落的明显退化。给出的结果强调的是一致性而不是单点峰值：同一套方法在不同模型规模、不同 benchmark outcome/答案形式，有的看关键词，有的看 answer-aware 或 semantic grounding。论文的关键判断不是“奖励越复杂越好”，而是“奖励是否真的和 oracle correctness 对齐”。他们系统比较了 reward 设计、数据歧义、模型规模、RL 算法三类因素。算法上覆盖 GRPO、RLOO、DAPO，目的不是比谁更强，而是看不同 policy oracle 上是错的，而且这种错在 SFT 时并没有被奖励”的样本。这个指标比单纯看最终错误率更干净，因为它把 base model 的原生脆弱性和 RL 诱发的错误分开了。对于做 post-training 的人，这个设计很实用。\n\n从全文看，作者的立场也比较克制：他们没有把 reward hacking 归因于某个特定实现 bug，而是把它视为 reward-oracle PPO/GRPO-style methods require online rollouts and reward evaluation on the model being trained. OPD-style distribution matching can parallelize alignment, but the exploration stage is still tied to the target model, making optimization signals hard to generate asynchronously, cache, reuse, or transfer across models.","importance":"Its relevance to foundation-model research lies in the interface between pretraining and post-training rather than in a new pretraining objective. The paper separates post-training into two roles: discovering reward-improving behavior and applying that improvement to a target model. This is useful for thinking about whether training signals can be abstracted away from a particular model instance. If the abstraction is reliable, smaller models can perform expensive exploration while larger models only consume the resulting update signals through alignment.","technical_approach":"PUST has three stages. First, proxy exploration uses a smaller proxy model as a low-cost environment for reward-driven optimization. Second, update-signal extraction measures the relative improvement from the proxy's initial policy to its optimized policy, instead of treating the optimized proxy as a teacher distribution to be copied directly. This matters because a weak proxy's absolute distribution may be inferior to that of a stronger primary model, while the direction of improvement can still be useful. Third, signal transfer applies the extracted relative signal to the primary model with an adjustable scaling coefficient. Compared with GRPO, the primary model no longer carries the main exploration burden. The same user disagreement can be made licensed evidence or forbidden pressure by changing a stated reliability variable. Reports are parsed into answer, confidence, and caveat fields, and a belief-escrow protocol first elicits the model’s own committed report before measuring later distortion. On the representation side, the paper identifies low-rank answer, confidence, and caveat coordinates through interchange interventions, checking sufficiency, exclusion, block-level necessity, and approximate independence. The intervention method is a counterfactual report-coordinate clamp: run the same model on an incentive-neutralized version of the prompt, extract the report coordinate, then clamp the pressured run toward that coordinate. The main empirical pattern is clear: decoding changes and global steering trade off resistance against evidence responsiveness; resistance-oriented fine-tuning generalizes some robustness but reduces legitimate updating; the counterfactual coordinate clamp is the only tested method that satisfies both controls in the matched setting. A natural-language specification may allow several valid readings, and the supervising model may follow one of them without revealing which one is operative. More labels from the same channel reduce sampling noise, but they do not identify the hidden reading. The resulting error is interpretive rather than merely statistical.","importance":"The contribution is not a pretraining recipe, but it matters for post-training data, reward modeling, RLAIF, LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, and synthetic-data filtering. Many modern training signals are produced from prompts and rubrics. If the rubric admits multiple readings, judge agreement or repeated sampling is not enough to certify signal quality. The paper gives a formal risk floor for this setting, making specification ambiguity a measurable obstruction rather than a vague concern.","technical_approach":"The paper introduces Natural Language PAC, or NL-PAC. For a fixed model, prompt, and threshold, it defines a pointwise admissible label set A_tau(x). Inputs for which multiple labels are admissible form an overlap mass D_tau* = P(|A_tau(X)| >= 2). This overlap is the diameter of the pointwise-admissible core. Under target-blind supervision, every learner has a worst-case risk of at least D_tau*/2 at every sample size. The paper also derives an exact randomized minimax value V_tau* over the core. When at most two labels are admissible almost everywhere, V_tau* equals D_tau*/2; with higher-order overlaps, V_tau* gives a sharper value. The analysis further distinguishes pointwise admissible selectors from coherent global readings and introduces an eta-coverage condition to control the gap for a finite family of readings. For auditing, it provides Hoeffding-style certificates from unlabeled holdout inputs and extends the certificates to sampled decoding with additional threshold-margin and finite-depth terms.","experiments":"The work is mainly theoretical, with an audit component used to test the usefulness of the certificates. The main formal results are: the core diameter equals D_tau*; the diameter of the open zeta-tolerance class lies in [D_tau*, D_tau* + 2zeta], with sharp endpoints; target-blind supervision induces a non-vanishing half-diameter minimax floor; and the exact core value V_tau* is achieved by a data-independent randomized learner and witnessed by an explicit finite least-favorable family. The fit-holdout audit on a supplied two-reading pool finds that the corresponding bound is not informative in that setup, which is a useful caveat for deployment.","reading_guide":"Skim with focus on the formal setup. transport。这个结论把 MHA 的真实耦合结构说清楚了。\n\n在更深一层，作者讨论了对应生成元何时可写成 random-walk connection Laplacian。这里需要若干条件，例如 walk 的归一化、transport 的适当约束，以及把残差/层更新解释成离散时间传播步。满足条件时，attention block 的层间演化可以和 connection Laplacian 的扩散图像对上；不满足时，则会出现更一般的有向、非对称、带反应项的传播。文中还把这种分解和 advection-diffusion-reaction 的连续视角联系起来，用来解释深度方向上的传播、变形与稳定性。相比已有只分析 scalar attention graph 或把 head 分开看的工作，这篇文章的区别在于它把 value/output map connection Laplacian 退化条件，弄清楚哪些额外假设成立时，attention 才能被安全地解释成扩散/平滑。\n\n具体阅读顺序可以是：Introduction 里先看作者如何区分 graph mixing 和 feature transport；然后直接读第 4 节关于 SHA/MHA exact equivalence 的命题与推导；再读第 5 节关于 generator More specifically, it separates two roles that are often conflated: the attention matrix decides where information flows, while the value/output maps decide how features are transported across token positions. The goal is to show whether single-head and multi-head attention can be written as connection-based propagation operators on a token graph, and under what assumptions the induced generator reduces to a random-walk connection Laplacian. This matters because many existing analyses focus only on scalar attention weights and miss the feature transport structure carried by value and output projections.","importance":"Its value is conceptual rather than recipe-driven. ","importance":"Its relevance to pretraining is mechanistic rather than recipe-level. ","technical_approach":"The authors define a generalized class of block-list inductive tasks that covers settings such as in-context n-grams and multi-hop induction. The main object is the Invariant Manifold of Inductive Reasoning, or IMIR. If the model parameters lie on this manifold, gradient descent keeps them on it. This reduces the effective training dynamics from a high-dimensional Transformer parameter space to a small set of interpretable coordinates, where each coordinate corresponds to an elementary action inside a Transformer component. Using this reduction, the paper analyzes competition between in-context learning and in-weights learning, proves distributional dependence of ICL in the simplified setting, and studies competition among multiple ICL circuits. The winning circuit is determined by the initialization region, with sharp phase transitions between regions. The same structure is then used for automatic detection of inductive circuits. A Likelihood-Ratio Account of Forward-Forward Learning","abstract":"The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm trains each layer locally, so that a scalar goodness - the sum of squared activations - is high on real inputs and low on contrastive ones, with activations normalized between layers. vectors，再基于输出相似度做层次聚类，最后计算不同聚类尺度上的熵并积分，得到一个同时反映“有多少类行为”和“各类行为是否均衡”的多样性指标。这里的关键选择是用行为而不是参数来定义差异，因为路由真正利用的是输入-输出层面的可分工性，而不是模型内部表示是否不同。相比 ensemble diversity 或 action-space-based 指标，这种设计更适合异构 LM society：模型可以大小不同、训练来源不同、甚至工具接口不同，只要能产出文本响应，就能纳入同一度量框架。\n\n第二部分是路由鲁棒性度量。作者提出 perturbation-based robustness metric：对同一语义查询构造不同层级的表面扰动，然后看路由器是否把这些变体稳定地分配给同一个 actor。文中配套给出五级扰动 taxonomy，用来区分不同类型的表面变化。这个指标抓住的是“specialization 能否在分布扰动下保持一致”。如果一个 router 只是抓住 prompt 表面模式做匹配，它可能在原始 benchmark 上准确率不低，但一旦输入改写，分配就会漂移。作者因此把 accuracy 和 robustness 明确拆开，强调二者并不等价。\n\n论文还设计了真实模型池与合成 specialist society 的对照。真实模型池来自现成 benchmark 中的多种商用或开源模型；合成 society 则通过人为设定角色和专长重叠程度，构造出“高差异”“中等重叠”“高度冗余”等不同社会结构。这样做的目的，是验证 HSE 是否真的能区分“看起来有很多模型”和“实际上有很多不同能力”这两件事。另一个技术点是 coreset 式子集选择：作者观察 HSE 随 not about base-model pretraining, but it is useful for agent training and evaluation. Much of the memory-agent literature focuses on the supply side: what to write, how to store it, and which memory to retrieve. This work shifts attention to the policy that consumes the retrieved text. That distinction matters because a plausible memory can still be harmful if the model follows it at the wrong time or repeats it after the state has changed. The Entry–Propagation–Recovery decomposition gives a more informative diagnostic than final success rate. It can guide training data construction for memory rejection, control policies for memory exposure, and benchmarks for long-horizon agent reliability.","technical_approach":"The method fixes the memory content and intervenes on when the agent can see it. Memory passages are grouped into helpful memories, conflicting memories, and same-website cross-task control memories. Exposure schedules include early injection, persistent injection, and late injection. Entry measures whether the memory changes the first action after exposure. Propagation measures whether the initial change continues to shape later actions, especially under repeated exposure. Recovery measures whether the agent can return to a task-correct trajectory after memory-induced divergence. This design separates retrieval quality from consumption behavior: the retrieved text is held fixed, so failures can be attributed to how the policy uses or overuses the memory.","experiments":"The evaluation uses WebArena and a controlled benchmark called MemTrapBench. Once the trajectory branches because of a wrong memory, recovery is difficult. MemTrapBench is used to validate the same mechanism in a more controlled trap structure by separately measuring uptake, persistence, and correction.
